`./compile.sh` reports **`compiled OK`**.

## What was delivered

`tests/org/apache/commons/lang3/text/ExtendedMessageFormatAgentTest.java` — a self-contained JUnit 4 test class (matching the JUnit 4.7 / 4.12 jars in `lib/`), in package `org.apache.commons.lang3.text`.

### Fixtures (all defined inside the file)
- `UpperCaseFormat`, `ConstantFormat`, `TagFormat` — local `java.text.Format` implementations.
- `RecordingFormatFactory`, `TagFormatFactory` — local `FormatFactory` implementations (the registry SPI the class Javadoc is built around).

### Coverage, every assertion tied to the `api/` contract

| Area | Tests |
|---|---|
| Plain patterns behave like `MessageFormat` | formatting equivalence vs a reference `MessageFormat`, extra args ignored, quoted braces stay literal, `toPattern()` round-trips, empty/no-element patterns, inherited `parse()` |
| Registry / custom formats | custom format applied, mixed custom+plain elements, `toPattern()` preserves the custom format name, factory receives **trimmed** name + style + the constructor locale, format-style drives the produced `Format`, registry **overrides** the built-in `number`, unknown name **falls through** to the built-in |
| `null` registry | documented "may be null" for both the 2-arg and 3-arg constructors |
| `applyPattern` | replaces the pattern; can introduce a custom format |
| Disabled mutators | `setFormat`, `setFormatByArgumentIndex`, `setFormats`, `setFormatsByArgumentIndex` each assert `UnsupportedOperationException` |
| Bad-pattern errors | unterminated element throws `IllegalArgumentException` for **all four** constructors; unknown format type throws too |
| `equals` / `hashCode` | equal for same pattern+locale (with matching hashCodes), unequal for different patterns, false for `null` / unrelated types, reflexive + stable hashCode |
